about: The world's ground as one height grid (documentation/terrain-height-grid-plan-2026-10-12.md). Stage 1 spec, 2026-10-12.
axes: Godot: x east, y up, z south. An image is a map, north up: row r is z = tile_z0 + spacing * r, column c is x = tile_x0 + spacing * c.
tile_edges: shared: a tile's last row and column repeat its neighbour's first, bit for bit
tile_origin: tile (tx, tz) starts at x = 1000 * tx, z = 1000 * tz

files.height: height/x{tx}_z{tz}.exr, one float32 channel, Godot y in metres, NaN where there is no ground of the master's
files.baseline: baseline/x{tx}_z{tz}.exr, the same from the frozen copy the generator measures change from
files.colour: colour/x{tx}_z{tz}.png, 8-bit sRGB RGBA, the land's colour at each node, alpha 0 where there is no ground

holes: holes.json: the outlines where generator-held ground (road corridor, tunnel lids, west shell, the anchors) meets the master's, from their open edges, exact
